source.title: Fleeing motorcyclist arrest
source.rights: Florida public record (Fla. Stat. ch. 119), released by the agency; Florida agencies cannot claim copyright in public records (Microdecisions, Inc. v. Skinner, 889 So. 2d 871, Fla. 2d DCA 2004). Faces of bystanders are blurred in anything we publish; names of arrested people are not used.

report:
A motorcycle fled from deputies during a traffic operation.
The motorcycle sped at high speed, weaving in and out of traffic.
The aviation unit was overhead when the rider stopped to refuel.
The rider stopped to refuel at a gas station.
The rider stopped voluntarily for deputies on the highway shoulder.
A passenger was riding on the back of the motorcycle.

claims.text: A motorcycle fled from deputies during a traffic operation.
claims.evidence: Aerial helicopter view follows motorcycles on the interstate with a white patrol vehicle behind while radio says "They're 12 half. weaving through traffic. traffic."
claims.reason: Video shows pursuit and speech describes fleeing behavior, with names/ranks not shown.

model.evidence: Aerial helicopter view follows motorcycles on the interstate with a white patrol vehicle behind while radio says "They're 12 half. weaving through traffic. traffic."
model.reason: Video shows pursuit and speech describes fleeing behavior, with names/ranks not shown.

claims.text: The motorcycle sped at high speed, weaving in and out of traffic.
claims.evidence: Aerial view shows motorcycle overtaking cars on the highway while radio says "He's cutting in and out of traffic." and "He He just passed your unit. high rate of speed."
claims.reason: Both the visuals of passing traffic and the radio descriptions confirm high speed weaving.

model.evidence: Aerial view shows motorcycle overtaking cars on the highway while radio says "He's cutting in and out of traffic." and "He He just passed your unit. high rate of speed."
model.reason: Both the visuals of passing traffic and the radio descriptions confirm high speed weaving.

claims.text: The aviation unit was overhead when the rider stopped to refuel.
claims.evidence: Overhead VOLUSIA SHERIFF aerial view zooms from wide gas station to close overhead of motorcycle stopped under the fuel canopy.
claims.reason: The continuous overhead perspective proves the aviation unit watched the refuel stop.

model.evidence: Overhead VOLUSIA SHERIFF aerial view zooms from wide gas station to close overhead of motorcycle stopped under the fuel canopy.
model.reason: The continuous overhead perspective proves the aviation unit watched the refuel stop.

claims.text: The rider stopped to refuel at a gas station.
claims.evidence: Overhead shows rider beside bike at pump island handling the pump while radio says "Okay, still got his helmet on, white helmet, black t-shirt, black pants, don't see a plate and he's got his credit card out paying for gas."
claims.reason: Video shows the stop at the pump and speech confirms paying for gas.

model.evidence: Overhead shows rider beside bike at pump island handling the pump while radio says "Okay, still got his helmet on, white helmet, black t-shirt, black pants, don't see a plate and he's got his credit card out paying for gas."
model.reason: Video shows the stop at the pump and speech confirms paying for gas.

claims.text: The rider stopped voluntarily for deputies on the highway shoulder.
claims.evidence: Overhead shows rider leaving the pump on the motorcycle and riding back onto the road while radio says "Okay, back on the go 44 eastbound"
claims.reason: Video shows continued flight after fueling rather than a voluntary stop for deputies on the shoulder.

claims.text: A passenger was riding on the back of the motorcycle.
claims.evidence: Close overhead of bike at pump 149 shows one person in black clothing and white shoes with the motorcycle and no second person on the back.
claims.reason: Only a single rider is visible on or with the motorcycle, contradicting a passenger.
